blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No Filipinos were injured in the most recent attack at King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said Thursday. On Wednesday evening, an attack was launched in the King Fahd International Airport killing one and injuring eight, according to the Saudi Civil Aviation Authority. “Wala pong Pinoy na napaulat na nasaktan [sa King Fahd International Airport] at patuloy po tayong nagmamanman ng sitwasyon,” Cacdac said in a dzMM radio interview. (“No Filipinos have been reported injured [at King Fahd International Airport] and we are continuing to monitor the situation.”) READ: Attack […]...
